besluite.fout: 'gekry' is repeated straight after the previous sentence in a different sense (the parents had a baby, Mila got a niece), which reads clumsily.
besluite.rede: The proposal removes the jarring repetition, keeps the same fact (the baby is Mila's first niece), and correctly adds the AWS comma between two full clauses.

besluite.fout: The fixed expression is incomplete without its article.
besluite.rede: 'die een na die ander' is the standard fixed Afrikaans expression and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: With Zanele as subject, 'haar' can be read reflexively, and 'geleer' can mean learn as well as teach, so the sentence could mean Zanele learned the words herself.
besluite.rede: Naming Mila with 'vir Mila' removes the ambiguity without adding information, since the same people, action and time remain.
